Openings and ways in (parts/fittings.mjs) now builds clean: 473 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette, and make.sh writes build.nbt.
Fix was to drop the 20 writes that landed on cells earlier parts already own (altar window, barn lintel, crib hatch, granary loft door, bay glazing, farmhouse loft window, schoolhouse-church lintel stairs). Each has a comment saying the shell already holds it.
Off-palette was already zero for this part; no palette swaps were needed.
left: Design openings lost (the fix removed them; the shell owns those cells): the farmhouse loft window (29..30, y 8..9, z 10), the church altar round window (52..53, y 9..10, z 17), the crib hatch (74, y 3..4, z 9, the shell's bamboo slats are there), and the granary loft door (x 79..80, y 7..8, z 9). Decide whether the shell should leave these openings clear, then restore them in fittings.mjs.

Other parts still refuse writes and need their own fixes (not touched here): roofs part REFUSED 18 (calcite quartz_slab at x49, y8, z9..16) and OFF-PALETTE (tuff_brick_stairs x62, tuff_bricks x5, polished_deepslate, cobbled_deepslate_stairs x7, polished_deepslate_stairs x3); chimneys part REFUSED 3 (65,13,15; 92,9,16; 90,9,16); cart lean-to REFUSED 3 (45,1,10; 45,1,13; 45,2,14); owner upper bedrooms REFUSED 2 (91,12,10; 87,12,10).
A flight warning remains: the landing at 86,7,9 has no headroom (owner flight, from the fittings/hearths part, not this part).
